purpose: Teach: 交信/逆説/マニフェスト/点在/入港/強者/待合室/首席

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外支社との交信を密にしろ
lines.en: I want tighter communication with our overseas branches.
lines.style: Sharp, authoritative opening. Clipped delivery — each phrase landing with weight. Direct eye contact. No room for interpretation. Calm but commanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。一見、逆説的な戦略も検討します
lines.en: Understood. We'll examine even counterintuitive strategies if needed.
lines.style: Measured, deferential response. Steady pace. Thoughtful pause between clauses. Professional assurance without overstatement. Shows he's genuinely considering what was asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、経営マニフェストを発表しろ
lines.en: Release our management manifesto to the public.
lines.style: Declarative, pushing forward. Emphasis on the final word. No hesitation. The tone of someone who's already decided and is now directing execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。支店が全国に点在しております
lines.en: Understood. Our branches are distributed nationwide.
lines.style: Factual confirmation. Slight lift at the end — offering relevant context without being asked. Calm, informative. Shows alignment and readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 輸送船の入港予定を管理しろ
lines.en: Keep close watch on cargo ship arrival schedules.
lines.style: Crisp, businesslike. Each instruction distinct. Slightly elevated pitch on the opening. The tone of someone delegating operational details with confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の強者と提携を進めます
lines.en: Understood. We're advancing partnerships with industry leaders.
lines.style: Confident, specific. Slight emphasis on 'advancing' — shows momentum. Measured pace. The reassurance of someone who knows what he's doing and is already in motion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様の待合室を快適にしろ
lines.en: Make the customer waiting area more welcoming.
lines.style: Shift in tone — warmer, less military. Still authoritative but softer entry. The instruction of someone thinking about the human experience. Deliberate, not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新入社員の首席を表彰します
lines.en: Understood. We'll commend our top new hire.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Small warmth at the end — recognition of the shift to people-focused matters. Professional but slightly more human. Dignified completion.
